newsitem.title: UK: Copper drifts lower during LME evening session.
newsitem.headline: Copper drifts lower during LME evening session.

text.p: Copper prices continued to drift lower during London Metal Exchange (LME) evening inter-office trading as traders continued to digest Monday's comments by Canadian scrap merchant Herbie Black.
Black, in a speech, suggested Sumitomo's copper positions still to be liquidated may total several hundred thousand tonnes.

Although this did not trigger a deluge of selling, buyers immediately went on the defensive and from a pre-speech level of $1,915 the three months delivery copper price dipped below $1,900. It eventually bottomed out at just above $1,890 during the evening session and at 1800 GMT it was quoted at $1,896/$1,899.
Other metals were little changed from last afternoon levels on the Exchange floor.
